Indian tourists die in Vietnam boat capsize; repatriation efforts underway

A boat accident in Vietnam has resulted in the deaths of 15 Indian tourists, with 21 survivors. Efforts are underway to repatriate the mortal remains of the deceased to India, with the Indian Embassy in Vietnam coordinating with local agencies. Several Indian states have set up control rooms and are seeking details on their affected residents.
